queries: Noa Lang injury Anfield PSG UEFA review stadium
PSG request UEFA investigate Anfield stadium Liverpool Champions League
rounds.what_returned: Multiple results immediately showing Noa Lang plays for Galatasaray (not PSG), and it was Galatasaray that filed the UEFA complaint — the tweet's core attribution is wrong. PSG did play Liverpool at Anfield but in a separate (later) Champions League tie.
rounds.lesson: The first round immediately surfaced the key factual error: wrong club. The tweet writer apparently confused PSG's upcoming CL quarter-final against Liverpool with Galatasaray's earlier round 16 match.

queries: Noa Lang Galatasaray Liverpool Anfield injury thumb advertising board March 2026
Galatasaray complaint UEFA Anfield Noa Lang PSG not involved
rounds.what_returned: Confirmed: match was Liverpool 4-0 Galatasaray on 19 March 2026 (CL round of 16 second leg). Galatasaray filed formal complaint with UEFA and threatened lawsuit. Multiple authoritative sources: Goal.com, OneFootball, Yahoo Sports, empireofthekop.com. No PSG involvement.
rounds.lesson: Anti-hindsight check: If I only knew the tweet claimed PSG requested this review, querying for both Galatasaray and PSG versions was valid. The second query explicitly testing PSG involvement returned zero evidence of PSG filing anything, confirming the misattribution.

what_helped: Searching for the player name + injury + stadium + UEFA immediately surfaced the correct club (Galatasaray), revealing the misattribution in the tweet
Running a second query explicitly checking PSG involvement confirmed the absence of any PSG complaint
Multiple corroborating sources from Goal.com, OneFootball, Yahoo Sports, empireofthekop.com all aligned on the same facts
what_hurt: The tweet's context (PSG Türkiye fan account, Turkish-language post) was plausible framing for a Galatasaray story — could have briefly caused confusion between two separate CL ties at Anfield
The image in the tweet shows a PSG jersey, which made the PSG connection seem plausible and could mislead readers who don't read carefully
insights.would_multipass_help: no — the error was identified in round 1; additional passes only confirmed what was already clear
insights.deepseek_advice: When a tweet attributes a specific action (complaint, lawsuit, request) to a club, first verify which club the named player actually belongs to — misattribution of club is a common error pattern. Search '[player name] [club]' before accepting the tweet's framing.
